[[File:Icon-device.png|40px]]

A '''Device''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type deployed on a character, location, or similar target. Devices stay in play like [[Effect]]s but are a separate type: [[Alter]] does not cancel Devices.

Premiere examples: [[Caller]], [[Hydroponics Station]], [[Vaporator]], [[Restraining Bolt]].
